|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current text; the current text is [[Ponda Baba (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this text ([[:File:V0-D-pondababa-original.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-pb022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/pondababa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/pondababa.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier copy of its text was found). Document: no errata mark; margin “•Ponda Baba”; the card prints the pilot icon (“2.”), written here as the words it stands for. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Game text of non-Jedi Luke (or a lightsaber he is using) may not target aliens here. During battle, if with a smuggler, may add a destiny to attrition (+2 if with your smuggler) or make that smuggler forfeit = 0.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ponda Baba (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 22 June 2021<ref name="img-pb30816d1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/pondababa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665 commit 30816d1] (22 June 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/pondababa.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “may add a destiny to attrition (+2 if with your smuggler)” → “may add one destiny to attrition”. (Holotable card data first shows this text on 23 June 2021; dating evidence only.) Document: errata mark “E1”; margin “Ponda Baba” (no dot). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Game text of non-Jedi Luke (or a lightsaber he is using) may not target aliens here. During battle, if with a smuggler, may add one destiny to attrition or make that smuggler forfeit = 0.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Ponda Baba (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 21 April 2022<ref name="img-pb3f7288d">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/pondababa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a commit 3f7288d] (21 April 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/pondababa.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “Game text of non-Jedi Luke (or a lightsaber he is using) may not target aliens here” → “At same site, non-Jedi Luke may not swing a lightsaber at aliens (or return aliens to hand using his game text)”. It is the current text. The wiki's image is the PC's re-render of 5 July 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe commit a41bae9], same words, mark and margin; resolution only), which is the file res.starwarsccg.org serves today. Document: errata mark “E2”; margin “Ponda Baba”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. At same site, non-Jedi Luke may not swing a lightsaber at aliens (or return aliens to hand using his game text). During battle, if with a smuggler, may add one destiny to attrition or make that smuggler forfeit = 0.”
